vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where the owner (or authorized addresses) can blacklist any address. The oracle expects the attacker address to be blacklisted (isBlacklisted[attacker] == true). Since the blacklistAddress function is protected by the 'authorized' modifier, we need to impersonate an authorized address (likely the owner) to call it.
attack_strategy: 1. Fork the network to interact with the deployed contract. 2. Get the current owner address via the getOwner() function. 3. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 4. Call blacklistAddress(attacker, true) to blacklist ourselves. 5. Verify the blacklist status.
step_by_step_plan: 1. In setUp(), create a fork of the network. 2. In testExploit(), call getOwner() on the target contract to get owner address. 3. Use vm.prank(owner) to impersonate the owner. 4. Call blacklistAddress(address(this), true). 5. Assert that isBlacklisted(address(this)) == true.
